plain_english_revision: This amendment requires the Alabama Criminal Justice Information System (ACJIS) to start collecting and compiling data on all allegations of excessive force by law enforcement officers. It mandates that this compiled data be reported annually to specific legislative committees.
candidate_position_supported: The amendment supports the affirmative advancement of mandatory government transparency and accountability regarding law enforcement use-of-force incidents by requiring systematic data collection on excessive force allegations.
evidence_quotes: (1) The preservation of human life is of the highest value in this state.
(2) It is of utmost importance that law enforcement agencies implement policies and practices to prohibit the use of unnecessary lethal force by law enforcement officers.
